items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Manuel Moneta is another one... I said I'd like to see Manuel. I hadn't seen him in a long time... He was a slide with Eddie Atkins that played, now Eddie Atkins is another performer who played with my husband

ctx.x: We talked to Mrs. Oliver, Joe Oliver's wife, Mrs. Stella Oliver. Yeah. She couldn't remember the name of his teacher.

She couldn't remember. Well, George taught him. I know that much. George taught him. I don't know who else taught him. I know. I'd ask him if Mrs. Perkins and he said no. I know that. And he taught him. He taught him how to play in the string music. With the string music. And I said often he'd come. But they're always in my home. I knew them well. I knew all of them. I knew all of them. Manuel Moneta is another one.
Yes. He talks about your husband.
